title: Chapter 40
text: 49 It eventually became clear to Colin that Starnes did not mean “the United States of America” but rather “this general area of south-central Tennessee.” 50 Haram is an Arabic word that means “forbidden by Islam.” 51 It’s cheesy, but that’s what they always said to each other: “I love you like crazycakes; I miss you like crazycakes;” etc. 52 True 53 And over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over and over.
